set_value.name: $shipyard
set_value.exact: @$job.$template.$shipyard == 1

set_value.name: $npc
set_value.exact: @$job.$source == 'NPC' and @$job.$approved and @global.$JKFOC_NPCJobs.indexof.{$job}

set_value.name: $valid
set_value.exact: $job.$ships.count == $job.$total and $job.$total ge 1 and $job.$total le 100 and $job.$home.exists and global.$JKFOC_FleetDrafts? and global.$JKFOC_ProtectedShipIDs? and ['APPLY APPROVED PLAN','FULL AUTOMATION'].indexof.{@global.$JKFOC_Authority}

set_value.name: $job.$deploymentmessage
set_value.exact: 'Awaiting complete delivery, native captains and unchanged ship orders.'

set_value.name: $job.$deploymentmessage
set_value.exact: if $job.$crewmessage? then $job.$crewmessage else 'Awaiting requested crew.'

do_elseif.value: $ship.owner != faction.player or not $ship.isoperational or $ship.macro != $e.$macro or $ship == player.controlled or not @$ship.assignedpilot.exists or $ship.ismission or global.$JKFOC_ProtectedShipIDs.indexof.{$ship.idcode} or $ship == @md.Story_Terraforming.Start.$BettyShip

set_value.name: $job.$deploymentmessage
set_value.exact: 'Ship has queued work or its queue is unavailable. No assembly will replace it.'

set_value.name: $job.$deploymentmessage
set_value.exact: 'Reviewed order queue or default parameters changed. Fleet left unassembled.'

do_if.value: @$ship.commander or $ship.allsubordinates.count or (if @$ship.order.exists then $ship.order != $expectedorder else @$expectedorder.exists) or (if @$ship.defaultorder.exists then $ship.defaultorder != $expecteddefault else @$expecteddefault.exists)

set_value.name: $job.$deploymentmessage
set_value.exact: 'Ship assignment or orders changed. FOC left the fleet unassembled.'

set_value.name: $role
set_value.exact: if $e.$macro.id == @$job.$template.$supportmacro then assignment.supplyfleet else assignment.defence

set_value.name: $job.$deploymentmessage
set_value.exact: 'Chosen flagship or support role could not be verified. No assembly attempted.'

set_value.name: $job.$state
set_value.exact: 'ASSEMBLY IN PROGRESS'

set_value.name: $role
set_value.exact: if $shipyard and $e.$macro.id == @$job.$template.$supportmacro then assignment.supplyfleet else assignment.defence

set_value.name: $followid
set_value.exact: if $role == assignment.supplyfleet then 'SupplyFleet' else if $e.$ship.iscapitalship and not $leader.iscapitalship then 'ProtectShip' else 'Escort'

set_value.name: $draft
set_value.exact: table[$commander=$leader,$commanderidcode=$leader.idcode,$fleetname=$job.$template.$name,$homekey=$job.$homekey,$homename=$job.$home.knownname,$homesector=$job.$home,$homex=0,$homey=0,$homez=0,$fleetrole='PATROL',$coverage='HOME SECTOR ONLY',$sectorchoice='PLAYER OWNED ONLY',$patrolpattern='LOOP',$respondships='YES',$respondstations='YES',$distress='PLAYER OWNED ONLY',$urgency=1,$shipdamage=100,$stationdamage=100,$returnhome='YES',$manualoverride=true,$locked=false,$noncombatoverride=false,$schema=4,$savedat=player.age]

set_value.name: $job.$state
set_value.exact: 'FLEET ASSEMBLED - HOME PATROL ORDERED'

set_value.name: $job.$deploymentmessage
set_value.exact: '%1 ships assembled. Home: %2. Patrol submitted; arrival is not yet confirmed.'.[$assigned,$job.$home.knownname]

set_value.name: $job.$state
set_value.exact: 'FLEET ASSEMBLED - READY FOR ASSIGNMENT'

set_value.name: $job.$deploymentmessage
set_value.exact: '%1 ships assigned. Gathering at %2; arrival not confirmed. Choose this fleet in Fleets to set Home and send its first mission. Auxiliary supplies are not purchased by this action.'.[$assigned,$job.$home.knownname]

set_value.name: $job.$state
set_value.exact: if $shipyard then 'ASSEMBLED - GATHER READBACK FAILED' else 'ASSEMBLED - PATROL READBACK FAILED'

set_value.name: $job.$deploymentmessage
set_value.exact: 'Fleet assembled and location retained. Check the leader in X4; requested order was not confirmed. No automatic retry.'

set_value.name: $job.$state
set_value.exact: 'PARTIAL ASSEMBLY - CHECK SHIPS'

set_value.name: $job.$deploymentmessage
set_value.exact: '%1 of %2 assignments confirmed. FOC stopped; no automatic replay or reassignment.'.[$assigned,$job.$total]
